source_of_truth.semantics: The successful installed inventory is authoritative. Requested selections are intent, receipts are evidence, and an inventory that cannot satisfy the dependency graph is inconsistent.

domain_errors.unknown-component: A named component is not core, github, or devtools.
domain_errors.components-not-accepted: The command does not accept component arguments.
domain_errors.missing-removal-target: remove requires one or more component arguments.
domain_errors.dependency-protected-removal: A requested removal is still required by a retained component.
domain_errors.no-recorded-selection: update requires a recorded installed component inventory.
domain_errors.inconsistent-installed-state: The installed inventory violates the dependency graph.
domain_errors.unknown-installed-component: The official Codexy marketplace inventory contains an unrecognized product.
domain_errors.conflicting-installed-state: An installed record does not match the selected official marketplace asset.
domain_errors.mixed-version-state: Installed Codexy components do not share one lockstep version.
domain_errors.component-version-mismatch: An installed component version is newer than the manifest target or differs from the required post-operation version.
domain_errors.invalid-installed-inventory: The host plugin inventory has an invalid shape.
domain_errors.conflicting-component-request: A component request contains a duplicate or conflicting operand.
domain_errors.incompatible-component-selection: A component selection is not in the manifest compatibility set.
domain_errors.installed-state-mismatch: The fresh installed inventory differs from the expected selection.
domain_errors.operation-failed: A mutation did not complete and the pre-operation selection was restored.
